annotations.title: Static Audit for Solidity Contracts & MCP Configs

description: Run a read-only static security and token-efficiency audit on Solidity smart contract source code (`.sol`) or MCP server JSON configuration files. Detects reentrancy, `tx.origin` auth, unchecked external calls, uninitialized proxies, and redundant prompt token bloat without executing the submitted code (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `risk_score` (0-100), `severity_counts`, `findings` (with remediation patches), and `estimated_savings_usd`. Use this tool for source-code and config auditing; use `check_mcp_poisoning` for fast runtime prompt-injection screening.

content.description: Full Solidity smart contract source code (`pragma solidity ...`) or JSON/YAML MCP server configuration content to audit statically.

target_type.description: Analyzer mode: `solidity` for EVM smart contracts, `mcp` for agent configurations, or `auto` to auto-detect from syntax. Defaults to `auto`.

name: audit_solidity_or_mcp
